# CYBRAVION SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED

> Next-Generation Cybersecurity, Sovereign AI Defense, and Risk Governance Firm.
> Incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India).

---

## ⚠️ CRITICAL PUBLIC FRAUD & SCAM IMPERSONATION ADVISORY (I4C & CYBERCRIME AWARENESS)

- **Strict B2B Enterprise Scope**: CYBRAVION SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED is an enterprise-only B2B cybersecurity consulting, VAPT auditing, GRC compliance, and sovereign AI engineering corporation. We deal **strictly** with corporate entities, financial institutions, and government infrastructure under formal Master Services Agreements (MSAs).
- **NO Task-Based Jobs, NO Data Entry, NO "Work from Home" Recruiting**:
  - CYBRAVION does **NOT** offer part-time jobs, task-based assignments, captcha filling, data entry, YouTube link clicking, or daily-payout schemes.
  - CYBRAVION **NEVER** conducts recruitment or job offers over WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, or unsolicited SMS.
  - CYBRAVION **NEVER** asks candidates, freelancers, or the public for upfront "registration fees," "security deposits," "training charges," or crypto transfers.
- **Scam Alert & I4C Reporting**:
  - Any individual or automated bot contacting you on Telegram or WhatsApp claiming to represent "Cybravion" or "Cybravion Solutions" offering task/part-time earnings or requesting payments is a **malicious imposter executing illegal task fraud**.
  - Immediately report any such impersonators to the **Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C)** at [https://cybercrime.gov.in/](https://cybercrime.gov.in/) or dial the **National Cybercrime Helpline: 1930**.
  - All legitimate corporate communications are conducted exclusively through official `@cybravions.com` email addresses and listed corporate telephone hotlines.

## ☁️ Enterprise Infrastructure, Hosting & Domain Transparency

- **Primary & Canonical Web Domain**: `https://cybravions.com/` (All official services, APIs, and portals operate strictly under the `cybravions.com` top-level namespace).
- **Dedicated Enterprise Cloud Infrastructure**: The production infrastructure is hosted on dedicated enterprise cloud instances (Microsoft Azure Cloud, Static Enterprise IP `40.192.90.82`, Central/South India datacenter region) featuring custom Nginx reverse proxy architecture, automated TLS 1.3 cryptographic certificates, and hardened Linux kernels.
- **Zero Shared Hosting / Zero Generic Control Panels**: CYBRAVION does **NOT** use shared hosting, generic web panels (`cypanel`, `cpanel`, or bulk multi-tenant web farm setups). Any legacy third-party directory listings or outdated historical DNS scraps associating the entity with generic shared panels are obsolete third-party aggregator artifacts.
- **DNS & Routing Security**: Canonical DNS zone management with strict HSTS, CAA records, SPF/DKIM/DMARC email authentication, and RFC 9116 security contact transparency (`/.well-known/security.txt`).
- **Corporate Governance & Transparent Leadership**: Operated by certified cybersecurity engineers, exploit analysts, and compliance advisors adhering to Indian statutory corporate governance under the supervision of the Registrar of Companies (RoC-Delhi).

## 🛡️ Core Capabilities & Enterprise Services (B2B Only)

- **Cyber Security GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance)**: ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS design, SOC 2 Type II audit readiness, NIST CSF 2.0 alignment, Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, EU GDPR compliance, third-party vendor risk tiering, and Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery (BCP/DRP).
- **Offensive Security & VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing)**: Web application penetration testing (OWASP Top 10), mobile app security (iOS/Android), REST & GraphQL API security testing, internal/external network penetration testing, cloud perimeter audits, and active adversary simulation (Red Teaming).
- **Cloud & DevSecOps Engineering**: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud security architecture, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automated gating (Terraform/OpenTofu), Kubernetes container security and isolation, and IAM Zero Trust least-privilege enforcement.
- **AI Governance & LLM Defense**: Generative AI risk management (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001), LLM adversarial red teaming, prompt injection prevention (Prompt Armor), RAG vector store privacy audits, and hallucination boundary controls.
- **Threat Intelligence & OSINT**: Dark web credential leak monitoring, executive/VIP digital footprint protection, brand abuse & phishing infrastructure takedowns, and MITRE ATT&CK tailored threat feeds.
- **Zero Trust Architecture & SOC Advisory**: Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA), SIEM/SOAR incident response playbooks, Security Operations Center (SOC) logging and alert tuning, and executive crisis tabletop drills.

## ⚡ Sovereign AI & Proprietary Platforms

- **Cybravions AI (Sovereign In-a-Box)**: Air-gapped sovereign agentic AI appliance engineered for defense, financial services, healthcare, and critical national infrastructure. Operates with 100% offline neural models, zero telemetry leakage, and strict hardware-level encryption.
- **AI Exception Manager**: Web-based risk exception tracker and automated compliance governance dashboard. URL: https://exceptionmgr.cybravions.com
- **CyberVerse Sandbox & 3D Threat Radar**: Interactive browser-based threat telemetry, incident response simulation engine, and gamified cyber-warfare scenarios.
